503:t_008:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「I'll provide support. I'm counting on you to take the vanguard.」

503:t_009:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「What shall we do, Miss $$スメラギ$$?」

503:t_009:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We planned for $$ヒイロ$$ and $$ゼクス$$ to seize the initiative, then watch the enemy's response. If they won't use the Vice Foreign Minister, we'll fight head-on.」

503:t_010:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Is $$バナージ$$ sensing something, too...!?」

503:t_010:5.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Watch out! Something else is coming out!」

503:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's a black $$ユニコーン$$...!」

503:t_011:2.en:
$$エマ$$
「Wasn't that supposed to have been lost...!?」

503:t_011:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「So those $$クロノ$$ bastards recovered it and brought it out again!」

503:t_011:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Is another $$強化人間$$ piloting it...!?」

503:t_011:9.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But those eyes... His expression is truly ominous.」

503:t_011:10.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I can't believe it... Ensign $$リディ$$, of all people...」

503:t_011:11.en:
$$デュオ$$
「He'd been a little strange toward the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, but I never thought he'd go this far...!」

503:t_011:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Drifting through space in a normal suit will do that to you.」

503:t_011:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! I'm glad you're safe...!」

503:t_011:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「I am no longer a member of $c.」

503:t_011:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What are you saying, Ensign $$リディ$$!?」

503:t_011:19.en:
$$シン$$
「Did $$クロノ$$ recruit you or something!?」

503:t_011:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「No... This was decided the moment I was born.」

503:t_011:22.en:
$$リディ$$
「Yes. For generations, the $$マーセナス家$$ has served as members of $$クロノ$$.」

503:t_011:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「A leading politician in the $$地球連邦$$ government... No, the family of the $$宇宙世紀$$'s first Prime Minister were members of $$クロノ$$...!」

503:t_011:25.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's precisely why something like $$ラプラスの箱$$ came into existence...」

503:t_011:27.en:
$$リディ$$
「I...learned the true meaning of $$ラプラスの箱$$.」

503:t_011:28.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is its true meaning...?」

503:t_011:29.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's why I'm fighting you...to seal the Box...to free $$ミネバ$$ from $$ジオン$$!」

503:t_012:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「He's different from how he used to be!」

503:t_012:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$'s pressure is reaching us through the $$バンシィ$$'s $$サイコ・フレーム$$...!」

503:t_012:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I never imagined his potential would awaken this way...!」

503:t_012:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! If only you weren't here, I...!」

503:t_012:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's no use, $$バナージ$$! Words won't reach $$リディ$$ as he is now!」

503:t_012:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But even so, this is...!」

503:t_012:11.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Fight. If you try to run, that black $$ユニコーン$$ will crush you.」

503:t_012:12.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Is that the future $$ゼロ#wing_zero$$ saw?」

503:t_012:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But fighting Ensign $$リディ$$ is...!」

503:t_012:15.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And don't think your life belongs only to you.」

503:t_012:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That means...protecting the $$ユニコーン$$...a future together with $$オードリー$$...」

503:t_013:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's right. There are things you must do.」

503:t_013:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You can do this, $$バナージ$$.」

503:t_013:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't intend to fight Ensign $$リディ$$.」

503:t_013:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I will stop that black $$ユニコーン$$!」

503:t_013:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is that how you look down on me!?」

503:t_013:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$バナージ$$! I'll defeat you with my own hands!」

503:t_013:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on the black $$ユニコーン$$! If we stop $$リディ$$, the enemy commander, this battle will be decided!」

503:t_013:9.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「What an idiot! He's not using the queen!」

503:t_013:10.en:
$$グエン$$
「It seems he still has a little pride left.」

503:t_013:11.en:
$$グエン$$
「Now...let us see how that affects the outcome.」

503:t_013:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Here I come, $$バナージ$$! I'll defeat you all and protect this world!!」

503:t_014:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Damn! Is the $$バンシィ$$'s tuning still insufficient!?」

503:t_014:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please stop, Ensign $$リディ$$! You must know what $$クロノ$$ has done, too!」

503:t_014:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You don't have to be bound by your family, your blood, or anything like that!」

503:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Shut up, $$バナージ$$! You don't understand anything!」

503:t_014:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「Not the true meaning of $$ラプラスの箱$$! Not the reason $$クロノ$$ exists!」

503:t_014:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Then tell us, Ensign! Tell us that true meaning!」

503:t_014:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What is $$クロノ$$ protecting!? How does that relate to your claim that you're protecting the world!?」

503:t_014:7.en:
$$リディ$$
「...It is...something you don't need to know.」
